notes.title: POSTAL 2 Redux has launched on Kickstarter
notes.notes:
POSTAL 2 Redux is now on Kickstarter with the developers gathering funding to make this enhanced Unity rebuild of the classic divisive game.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/08/postal-2-redux-has-launched-on-kickstarter/

notes.title: The Redux Run-Up: Counting Bodies and Answering Questions
notes.notes:
[p][b]You wouldn’t stop asking, so we stopped dodging Molotovs and wrote it all down.

[/b]POSTAL 2 Redux is real, a love letter to the original, upgraded with all the power of today’s tech and yes—your unhinged demands absolutely helped make this mess happen.  Below is the full FAQ: what Redux actually is, why we’re doing it this way, how VR fits, exactly when you’ll be “[i]hosing down[/i]” Paradise in higher fidelity, and what fresh hell unlocks when our pre‑launch follower numbers spike.[/p][p]Before you scroll: [b]hit [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/postal2redux/postal-2-redux"]“[i]Notify me[/i]” on the Kickstarter[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3839180/POSTAL_2_Redux/"]wishlist on Steam[/url], and [url="https://discord.gg/85G72u8Ejn"]pile into Discord[/url].[/b] Every new warm body pushes us closer to stretch goals that should probably be illegal.[/p][p][/p][h3][i]"Our goal is simple, make POSTAL 2 Redux the best damn game it deserves to be."    POSTAL 2 is coming back for modern hardware in [/i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3534150/POSTAL_2_VR/"]both VR[/url][i] and [/i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3839180/POSTAL_2_Redux/"]non-VR platforms[/url][i]. 
[/i][/h3][p]The [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/postal2redux/postal-2-redux"]Kickstarter Pre-launch [/url]is now live. Give it a follow in order to unlock new rewards. We are closing in to our first goal, giving Mike J some new moves and an updated look, but we'll need your support to get Steamworks Support and a super-fun pigeon mission into the game. More details below. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683116/8add13576723117e2e2e5a822e5fb44087a48b14.jpg"][/img][/p][h1][b]Pre-Launch Stretch Goals[/b][/h1][p]Spread the word about POSTAL 2 Redux before the Kickstarter campaign opens in order to unlock exclusive rewards![/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td][p]6,000 Followers[/p][/td][td][p]Mike J's New Moves / New Look (now with Hair!)[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]8,000 Followers[/p][/td][td][p]POSTAL 4 Outfit for the POSTAL Dude[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]10,000 Followers[/p][/td][td][p]Steamworks Modding Support[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]15,000 Followers[/p][/td][td][p]Super-Fun Pigeon Hunter Mission[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]
 [url="https://x.com/POSTAL2redux" style="button"]Check the current status on X[/url][/p][h3][b]Mike J's New Moves / Hair and Beard:[/b][/h3][p]It's said there are two certainties in life. One is taxes and the other is that Mike J will bust a move when you piss on him. No Redux of POSTAL 2 would be complete without teaching him some new moves. And what better way to show them off but with hair and a beard the latest graphical technology 2025 has to offer. Get it all wet![/p][h3][b]POSTAL 4 Outfit:[/b][/h3][p]2003 Trenchcoat-chique is always in fashion. But sometimes the dude wants to kick back in his favourite dressing gown. Unlockable POSTAL 4 outfit is yours for the mere price of following the campaign. [/p][h3][b]Steamworks Support:[/b][/h3][p]We often hear "you suck, I could do better". After we've given Mom her sleeping pills we have to admit she had a point. Hitting this goal adds Steamworks support into Redux. Dream my beautiful modders! [/p][h3][b]Super-Fun Pigeon Hunter Mission:[/b][/h3][p]The Pigeons Will Pay.  You asked. You begged. Many a shrine made of bird bones was pissed on. Now we're finally bringing the Super-Fun Pigeon Hunter Mission to life for real this time. Vince screamed at the accountants, so we got new accountants. Deaf accountants. Nothing can stop this happening other than not hitting this follower goal. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683116/8a92aa34f690a376f5112dbb2871fbf8eddbef40.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Frequently Asked Questions[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Why are you making this when [i]POSTAL 4[/i] isn’t done?[/b][/h3][p][i]POSTAL 2 Redux is being made (Team Beef) and published (Impact Inked) externally, so it has no effect on Running With Scissors’ internal projects. [/i]
[/p][h3][b]Why a remake when the original is “perfect”?[/b][/h3][p][i]We started this journey because we’re fans. Hardcore POSTAL fans. POSTAL 2 has a place in our hearts (and hard drives), and we believe it deserves a place on every modern console too. This isn’t simply a port to modern consoles. It’s preservation with purpose. We're keeping everything you love intact. Wherever we enhance or improve, we do so with the original in mind. With Running With Scissors by our side, one thing’s certain: it’s still POSTAL. It’s still the Dude.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Will there be localized dubs?[/b][/h3][p][i]We’re aiming for as many languages as possible. There are some wrinkles to iron out with older dubs, and possibilities for new ones—more news to follow.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Regional restrictions?[/b][/h3][p][i]We’re aware of issues in Germany, New Zealand, and a few other regions. We have plans to give Redux the best chance everywhere, but final approval rests with regional authorities. We cannot guarantee that POSTAL 2 VR and POSTAL 2 Redux will ultimately be available everywhere, but we can guarantee that we will fight to give players worldwide access to the game.[/i]
[/p][h3][b]Multiplayer / Co-op?[/b][/h3][p][i]Potential stretch-goal territory, but doesn’t feel like POSTAL if you can’t cross streams with your friends. [/i]
[/p][h3][b]What does “Redux” mean—remaster, remake, or what?[/b][/h3][p][i]Redux moves the game into Unity. We start with original assets and logic, then upgrade, replace, and add brand-new content that’s not present in the original game. Fear not. It’s still POSTAL 2… just Reduxed. [/i]
[/p][h3][b]Will Rick Hunter’s original lines return? New lines? [/b][/h3][p][i]Rick Hunter may have some new lines.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Release window?[/b][/h3][p][i]Targeting 2026. Exact timing depends on development and stretch-goal scope.[/i]
[/p][h3][b]Censorship?[/b][/h3][p][i]If we don’t have to change it, we won’t. Platform holders may request tweaks, but PC will remain uncensored. We’re confident we can reach every major storefront with minimal edits.[/i]
[/p][h3][b]Platforms - Xbox? [i]Seriously?[/i] PS5? PS4? Switch 2? Mobile?[/b][/h3][p][i]Our aim is to provide POSTAL 2 Redux on every possible platform. For more details, follow the Kickstarter! ;)[/i]
[/p][h3][b]How are VR and Redux Different? [/b][/h3][p][i]To clarify, this Kickstarter funds a single product: POSTAL 2 Redux. However, both Redux and the VR version will share a common core, meaning improvements will benefit both flat-screen and VR simultaneously. If you're only interested in the VR version, note that any stretch goals achieved through this campaign will also apply to it. That said, unlike POSTAL 2 Redux, the release of POSTAL 2 VR is not contingent on the success of this Kickstarter.[/i][/p][p][i]Building them in tandem leads to smarter development: shared gameplay improvements, more efficient and wider testing, and better polish across the board.  We're also looking into the most cost-effective way for backers to own both, if they choose to. We’ll share more information as we get closer to launch.
[/i][/p][h3][b]Will the original be delisted?[/b][/h3][p][i]No.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Why Unity?[/b][/h3][p][i]Unity is the ideal engine for a multi-platform remaster because it offers powerful cross-platform support, letting us target PC, consoles, and even mobile from a single code-base. Its customizable art pipelines and shader systems allow us to faithfully recreate the original game’s look or enhance it with modern touches, while giving artists direct control over visual fidelity. With flexible tooling, fast iteration, and support for both legacy-style visuals and modern rendering features, Unity strikes the perfect balance between preservation and progress.
[/i][/p][h3][b]When to expect more info?[/b][/h3][p][i]Click “Follow” on the [u][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/postal2redux/postal-2-redux"]Kickstarter pre-launch page[/url][/u] to get every update the moment it drops this summer.[/i]
[/p][h3][b]What content ships day-one? DLC? Extra missions?[/b][/h3][p][i]This will scale with Kickstarter performance and stretch goals. Stay tuned.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Will Mike J still dance if you piss on him?[/b][/h3][p][i]If history is any indicator, nothing can stop Mike J from busting a move whilst taking a golden shower! Maybe he’s learned some new moves. Only time will tell. [/i]
[/p][h3][b]Will the game support modding / SteamWorks?[/b][/h3][p][i]We love modding. Some members of the development teams started their professional careers as modders (as did RWS staff). More information will be shared soon, but stretch goals could bring official mod support to both PC and consoles![/i]
[/p][h3][b]Will existing owners of POSTAL 2 get Redux for FREE?![/b][/h3][p][i]POSTAL 2 Redux is a huge joint effort between Running With Scissors, Team Beef, and Impact Inked, so owning a copy of the original game does not get you a free copy. We’re pouring every ounce of love (and bodily fluid) we have into POSTAL 2 Redux to make sure it's as beloved as the original and worth every penny.[/i][/p][h1]
Still here? Good. Now do the part that hurts (us) the least:[/h1][list][*][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/postal2redux/postal-2-redux"]Follow the Kickstarter pre‑launch page[/url] so you’re there when the match hits the gasoline.
[/p][/*][*][p][url="https://discord.gg/85G72u8Ejn"]Join the Discord [/url]and scream at us directly.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wishlist on Steam[/b] (flatscreen, VR, or both. It’s your call).[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3839180/POSTAL_2_Redux/"][/dynamiclink] [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3534150/POSTAL_2_VR/"]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3534150/POSTAL_2_VR/[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]Share this post[/b] with someone who deserves a shovel to the face. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683116/17dac6f4927f3690fb36de927e0ab8b705e36c80.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]That’s it. You’ve got the info—go weaponize it. We’ll see you when the sirens start.[/p][h3] We are also launching a giveaway to celebrate. 
[url="https://gleam.io/BiVrM/postal-2-redux-kickstarter" style="button" buttoncolor="#000000"]Enter on Gleam![/url][/h3]
